summary: New Found Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K with an attached news release dated August 14, 2026, announcing routine equity compensation grants. The company granted incentive stock options to acquire 1,499,543 common shares at an exercise price of $2.37 per share, exercisable for five years, plus 782,680 RSUs and 128,454 DSUs to officers and directors. Vesting schedules are standard: RSUs vest in thirds annually, DSUs fully vest after one year. This is an ordinary equity grant disclosure, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic action, or unusual corporate event is present. The filing also notes conditional approval to graduate to the TSX, a routine listing update. Watch for no risk-arb angle; no deal terms are applicable.
